rationale: With only 29 minutes to close and a stock that has already moved -29% on the day and recovered ~78% of its intraday range, the near-term directional edge is unclear — the last five candles show modest drift lower but the 5-min ATR of $0.08 is extremely compressed relative to the day's range, suggesting momentum has largely exhausted.
